svg.title: How the reader turns raw per-rank records into the fifteen derived tables that the UI, the agent and the test suite query
svg.desc: Hand-authored layout, emitted by tools/gen_figures.py. The record set was cross-checked against the COMSHU_RECORD declarations by hand; nothing enforces it.
svg.text: the same edges, split by size class
one row per local queue pair
every touch, as an offset in an object
which kernel issued a GPU send
every event on one wall clock
what a UCP send became on the wire
the tag a msg_recv did not carry
where a collective became peer traffic
what the TRACER was asked to do
what the graph could NOT account for
WHAT THE PANELS AND THE SUITE READ
